messages:
liz: Quick sync: following the postmortem, we need to lock down auto-rollback cooldowns, sample-size minima, and DB-migration exceptions. Who can own what?

cheng: I can own the sampling and detector side. Will sketch traffic thresholds and a minimum RPS per canary shard.

sam: I'll take rollback behavior and cooldown logic. thinking: 30m cooldown + max 2 rollbacks/hr sounds sane?

amar: I'll update SLO doc + add a migration flag so detectors ignore expected errors during migrations. we had noise from that.

maria: I'll formalize the "customer-impacting" vs "infra-only" signal definitions so auto-rollback doesn't flip for infra blips.

liz: notes: last incident pattern = small canary + DB migration -> noisy errors but customer impact was limited. add explicit rule: pause auto-rollback when migration_in_progress=true OR active_migration_ticket present.

cheng: suggested sampling table:

- canary_percent: 1-10% depending on service criticality
- min_rps_for_alerting: 200 (per shard)
- min_sample_window: 3 min

also: require at least 3 canary instances active before triggering fatal actions.

sam: snippet for flag gating people can copy:

```json
{
  "auto_rollback": true,
  "cooldown_minutes": 30,
  "max_rollbacks_per_hour": 2,
  "min_rps_for_alerting": 200,
  "min_canary_instances": 3,
  "ignore_during_migration": true
}
```

amar: for migration detection we can integrate with the deploy pipeline: set migration label on deploy metadata. also add an audit check so humans have to confirm if migration label present and customer-impacting signal fires.

maria: for signals: customer-impacting = percentage of 5xx from edge > 0.5% sustained 5m OR user-visible error rate increase > 2x baseline. infra-only = internal infra error spikes without increase in user-facing errors.

liz: ownership summary: cheng -> sampling table + simulator; sam -> rollback engine + cooldown; amar -> SLO + migration gating; maria -> signal defs + test kit. I will review drafts.

deploy-bot: deploy event: canary rollout 2026-03-24T09:12:00Z started by @cheng 2% sampling

cheng: I will add a lightweight simulator script in the PR to validate edge cases (small sample sizes causing flapping).

sam: question: what about retries/clients that amplify errors? propose to use deduped request counts at edge and ignore retried requests when computing RPS for alerting.

amar: agree, add header-based dedupe: X-Request-ID. if absent, fall back to ip+path heuristics. document in playbook.

maria: Also let's add a canary ramp policy: 2% -> 10% over 10m with hold checks at each step. If any hold fails, rollback.

liz: timeline: cheng/sam: initial PRs by Tue (1895092800), review Wed, ship v0 by Fri. amar/maria: SLO + tests by Thu.

cheng: ack. labeling tasks now.

sam: acked. I'll include unit tests for cooldown and rollback counters.

incident-bot: reminder: postmortem follow-up meeting scheduled 2026-03-31 11:00 UTC

liz: thanks — please add PR links to the postmortem doc once ready. we'll review simulator outputs in the follow-up meeting.

maria: added tasks: https://redwood.inc/tasks/ROLL-452 :calendar: 

liz: closing loop: owners and deadlines firm unless folks raise blockers by EOD tomorrow.
